Aakhri line kehti hai ki 'agar hum artificial tareeqe se inn painful memories ko mita de jo humein mature karti hain, toh humein kya risk hai?' Option B perfect dark conclusion deta hai: humara dimaag andar se khokhla (hollowed) ho jayega, jisme dard toh nahi hoga, par wo grow karne ya kisi se empathy (hamdardi) rakhne ke bhi qabil nahi rahega.
trick: The text builds a 'trade-off' argument (alleviating pain vs losing character growth). The conclusion starting with 'we risk' must highlight the negative side of this trade-off. Option B elegantly describes the loss of character growth ('incapable of profound psychological growth').
tip: 'Pain forms character' ke premise me, agar pain mita diya toh character growth rukk jayegi.
